text:
imid
Description
Parses the BIG-IP 4.X
http_uri
variable and the
user-agent
header field to return an i-mode identifier string that can be used
for i-mode session persistence. This is a BIG-IP 4.X function,
provided for backward compatibility.
The
imid
function takes no arguments and simply returns the string
representing the i-mode identifier or the empty string, if none is
found.
Note: The
imid
function currently does not work. This issue is
tracked by CR96666.
Syntax
imid
imid
Parses the BIG-IP 4.X
http_uri
variable and the ‘’’user-agent*
header field to return an i-mode identifier string that can be used
for i-mode session persistence.
